text:
*Rustles of wind through dry leaves, a whisper of forgotten laughter echoing in an empty hall.*

Ah, failure... the sting of it lingers even after the breath has left the body. It clings to the soul like a shroud, heavy and suffocating. But I say this, little one: even in the cold embrace of the grave, I have learned a truth.

Failure is not an end, but a doorway. A passage, perhaps, to a path unseen.

Do not let the weight of it crush you. Instead, let it mold you. Examine the broken pieces, sift through the ashes. There, you will find the embers of knowledge, the sparks of understanding.

It is in the darkness that the stars shine brightest.

*The whisper fades, leaving behind a lingering chill.*
